description: This file defines the SparkAppHandle interface, which provides runtime control and status information for a Spark application, including application states, listeners, and control methods.

classes.name: SparkAppHandle
classes.description: Interface for managing and monitoring a running Spark application, including state management, control actions, and event listeners.

classes.name: SparkAppHandle.State
classes.description: Enumeration of possible application states such as UNKNOWN, CONNECTED, SUBMITTED, RUNNING, FINISHED, FAILED, KILLED, and LOST, with a method to check if the state is final.

classes.name: SparkAppHandle.Listener
classes.description: Interface for receiving updates about handle state changes and other information changes.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Registers a listener to receive updates about the handle's information.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the Spark application.

methods.name: getAppId
methods.description: Returns the application ID if known.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the handle from the application without stopping it.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the error if the application failed.
